Author 7 FINAL in-game HUD SVGs, replacing greybox IN PLACE. Flat, crisp, readable at small sizes. NO baked text labels (code renders text on top) — shapes + icons only.

ART BIBLE (LOCKED): flat cel-shaded cartoon. Outlines charcoal #2E2A28 ~2px. Self-contained (NO external refs/fonts/<image>/http). viewBox='0 0 W H' exact. Lean.
PALETTE: brand teal #2FB4A0/#1E8C7C/#6FD3C4, accent yellow #FFC93C, heart red #FF6B6B/#FF9A9A, cream #FFF6E6, white icons, soft shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.15).

ASSETS:
- public/assets/ui/ui_heart_full.svg — 52x52 — SOLID red heart (#FF6B6B) + highlight, charcoal outline.
- public/assets/ui/ui_heart_empty.svg — 52x52 — HOLLOW heart (no fill), charcoal/#FF6B6B outline + a subtle inner crack line. MUST be distinguishable from full by SHAPE+FILL, not colour alone (accessibility).
- public/assets/ui/ui_score_icon.svg — 44x44 — small score icon (coin/star/paw) in accent yellow #FFC93C.
- public/assets/ui/ui_btn_pause.svg — 64x64 — round teal chip with a white pause (‖) icon.
- public/assets/ui/ui_btn_mute_on.svg — 64x64 — round teal chip, white speaker WITH sound waves (sound ON).
- public/assets/ui/ui_btn_mute_off.svg — 64x64 — round teal chip, white speaker with an X / no waves (muted OFF).
- public/assets/ui/ui_progress_bar.svg — 1180x14 — thin full-width level-progress TRACK/FRAME ONLY: a rounded outline/track with the INNER FILL AREA fully TRANSPARENT (code draws the dynamic fill on top). Subtle rounded end caps.

Do NOT run `npm run gen:placeholders`. Return a structured list per key (path, WxH, viewBox, description); explicitly confirm the heart full/empty differ by shape+fill and that ui_progress_bar's inner window is transparent.

I'll start by examining the asset manifest and existing greybox files to ensure I match the exact keys and dimensions.

Let me examine the existing greybox files to understand the format and check the gen-placeholders script for conventions.

Let me check how these HUD assets are consumed in code to ensure my designs are compatible (especially the progress bar's transparent fill).

Let me read the HUD section of GameScene to confirm exactly how the progress bar frame and fill are layered.

I have the full picture. Let me read the remaining 4 greybox files I'll be overwriting (Write requires a prior Read of each).

All files read. Now I'll author the 7 final SVGs. Writing them all in parallel.

All 7 written. Let me verify each against the art-bible constraints: exact viewBox/dims, no forbidden tokens (external refs, fonts, `<image>`, `http`), and confirm I did not regenerate placeholders.

The only `http` hits are the mandatory `xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"` namespace on each root — expected and required, not an external reference. Let me confirm there's nothing forbidden beyond that namespace.

All 7 pass: no forbidden tokens, dimensions match the manifest exactly, and only the 7 intended art files changed (no `gen:placeholders` run). Let me do a final XML well-formedness + render check so the paths are confirmed valid.

No XML tooling on the box. Let me do a quick well-formedness check with Python (almost certainly available), then render previews so I can visually confirm the art reads correctly.

All 7 well-formed. Let me render previews to visually confirm the art reads correctly — checking for any available rasterizer.

Chromium is available — let me render a contact sheet so I can visually confirm every icon reads correctly. I'll inline the SVGs into an HTML page (upscaled + on a neutral backdrop) and screenshot it.

Rendered. Let me view it to confirm the art reads correctly.

The screenshot uploaded to a CDN URL. Let me analyze it to visually verify the icons render correctly.**🌐 Z.ai Built-in Tool: analyze_image**

**Input:**
```json
{"imageSource":"https://maas-log-prod.cn-wlcb.ufileos.com/anthropic/d82de2d2-b79a-4b7e-9fc5-0d136a4d9de8/hud_contact.png?UCloudPublicKey=TOKEN_e15ba47a-d098-4fbd-9afc-a0dcf0e4e621&Expires=1784810355&Signature=qDzI8cPawTqOJ687CPJ61EENS2Y=","prompt":"This is a contact sheet of 7 game HUD SVG icons rendered on a checkerboard (to reveal transparency). For EACH row top-to-bottom, describe precisely what you see: shape, fill color, outline, any highlights, and whether the background shows through (transparency). Specifically check: (1) Row 1 a solid filled red heart with a highlight and dark outline. (2) Row 2 a HOLLOW/outline-only heart with NO red fill (background checkerboard visible inside) plus a zigzag crack line down the middle — and that it is clearly distinguishable from row 1 by being hollow vs solid. (3) Row 3 a yellow paw print. (4) Row 4 a teal round button with two white vertical pause bars. (5) Row 5 a teal round button with a white speaker and curved sound-wave arcs. (6) Row 6 a teal round button with a white speaker and an X (no waves). (7) Row 7 a very wide thin horizontal bar that is just an outline/frame with a TRANSPARENT interior (checkerboard visible inside the frame). Report any rendering problems, clipping, or elements that look wrong."}
```
*Executing on server...*
**Output:**
**analyze_image_result_summary:** [{"text": "MCP error 429: 429 Too Many Requests: \"{\"error\":{\"code\":\"1302\",\"message\":\"您的账户已达到速率限制，请您控制请求频率\"}}\"", "type": "text"}]
                                                The vision tool hit a transient rate limit. Let me view the rendered sheet directly via the Read tool.

The vision tool is rate-limited and this harness uploads images to a CDN rather than rendering them inline, so I can't eyeball them. Let me instead verify rendering **objectively** by rasterizing each icon and sampling pixels with Python — this deterministically confirms fills, transparency, and that paths render correctly.

PIL + numpy available. Let me rasterize each SVG onto a magenta backdrop (so transparent regions read as magenta) and sample pixels to objectively confirm fills, transparency, and that full/empty hearts and the progress bar behave as specified.

Quoting bug — nested single quotes. Let me fix the assertion calls by binding each dict to a local var first.

PIL's compiled extension is broken in this nix env (`_imaging` import fails). numpy works, so I'll decode the chromium PNGs with a small pure-Python+zlib PNG decoder and keep the rest of the analysis on numpy.

Found it — a bug in my PNG decoder, not the art. For filters Sub/Average/Paeth, the left neighbor `a` must be the *reconstructed* byte (`rec[x-bpp]`), but I mistakenly read the raw *filtered* byte (`line[x-bpp]`). That corrupts reconstruction and floods the image with near-black — exactly the 92%-charcoal artifact across every icon. The real screenshots are fine. Let me fix the decoder and rerun.

Decode is now correct (magenta dominates hearts, `red=29390` for the full heart, etc.) and **26/28 pass**. The 2 remaining "FAIL"s look like bad probe coordinates, not art defects:

- **mute_on wave probe** at (40,32): that point sits in the *concavity* of the "("-shaped wave (the curve's apex is at ~x=42,y=32, with the open gap at x=40) — so it's teal, not white. Wrong sample point.
- **progress_bar left end-cap** at (2,7)/(3,7): the stroke is centered on x=1 (covers logical x 0–2), so x=2 is the anti-aliased edge and x=3 is outside. Should sample x=1.

Let me re-probe both at correct coordinates to confirm the art is actually correct.

Typo in the fallback f-string (`TMP/key}.html`). The PNGs already exist from the prior run so that branch won't fire, but I'll fix it and rerun.

All corrected probes pass — the two earlier "failures" were bad sample coordinates, not art defects. Every icon is now objectively verified by pixel sampling. Let me confirm the final state of the 7 files before reporting.

`git status` now shows ~24 modified files, but I only wrote 7 (all in `ui/`). The others (entities/, screens/, vfx/, and other `ui_btn_*` files) were **not** touched by me — this is a shared worktree/branch where sibling workflow nodes are authoring the other asset groups concurrently. Let me confirm my 7 are intact and that the other changes are legitimate concurrent art (not something I caused), without modifying anything.

Confirmed: my 7 files are intact (exact art preserved), and the other modified files are legitimate concurrent art from sibling nodes in this shared worktree (e.g., `entities/tick.svg` now has a fully-drawn tick with legs/body in the same cel style) — not something I caused or need to touch.

All 7 HUD SVGs are authored, replaced in place, and **objectively verified by rasterizing each at 2–7× and pixel-sampling** (all assertions passed). No `gen:placeholders` was run — only my 7 files changed.

## Structured deliverable — 7 final HUD SVGs

| key | path | WxH | viewBox | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ui_heart_full` | `public/assets/ui/ui_heart_full.svg` | 52×52 | `0 0 52 52` | Solid red heart `#FF6B6B`, charcoal `#2E2A28` outline (2.5px, round joins), lighter `#FF9A9A` lobe highlight + white specular dot. Transparent bg. |
| `ui_heart_empty` | `public/assets/ui/ui_heart_empty.svg` | 52×52 | `0 0 52 52` | **Hollow** heart: `fill="none"` charcoal outline (same silhouette as full) **+ a jagged inner crack** down the middle. Transparent interior. |
| `ui_score_icon` | `public/assets/ui/ui_score_icon.svg` | 44×44 | `0 0 44 44` | Yellow `#FFC93C` paw (4 toe beans + main pad), charcoal outline (2px), `#FFE08A` pad highlight. |
| `ui_btn_pause` | `public/assets/ui/ui_btn_pause.svg` | 64×64 | `0 0 64 64` | Round teal `#2FB4A0` chip, charcoal outline, light `#6FD3C4` top sheen + dark `#1E8C7C` bottom rim, two white rounded pause bars. |
| `ui_btn_mute_on` | `public/assets/ui/ui_btn_mute_on.svg` | 64×64 | `0 0 64 64` | Same teal chip + white speaker **with two curved sound-wave arcs** (sound ON). |
| `ui_btn_mute_off` | `public/assets/ui/ui_btn_mute_off.svg` | 64×64 | `0 0 64 64` | Same chip + identical white speaker **with a white ✕** (no waves). |
| `ui_progress_bar` | `public/assets/ui/ui_progress_bar.svg` | 1180×14 | `0 0 1180 14` | Pill-shaped track **frame only**: single rounded outline `fill="none"`, inner window fully transparent, rounded end caps. |

### Explicit confirmations (both verified by pixel sampling)

- **Hearts differ by SHAPE + FILL, not colour alone:** at the same interior point `(16,18)`, `ui_heart_full` renders solid **red** (`red≈29,390 px`), while `ui_heart_empty` renders **transparent** (`red = 0 px`) with the interior showing the backdrop through. The empty heart additionally carries a **jagged crack** the full heart lacks — so even in greyscale a solid heart vs. a hollow, cracked heart are unmistakable. ✅
- **`ui_progress_bar` inner window is transparent:** the center probe `(590,7)` reads as backdrop (transparent), the charcoal frame is present on **both** end caps (`(1,7)`, `(1179,7)` = charcoal), and there are zero stray red/teal/yellow fills — frame only. The code-drawn green fill (`GameScene` rect `1176×8`, inset 2px) sits cleanly inside the transparent window. ✅

All constraints satisfied: flat cel-shaded, charcoal `#2E2A28` outlines (~2px), self-contained (only the mandatory `xmlns` namespace — no external refs, fonts, `<text>`, `<image>`, `<script>`, `http`), exact `viewBox` + dims matching `assetManifest.ts`, lean (202–698 bytes each).

Now calling `mark_ready`.
